Prefill pressure refers to the initial data that must be processed before the model begins decoding, which can impact latency. The decode tail involves the subsequent data processing, which may require additional GPU resources. KV cache transfer ensures efficient data movement between the model's cache and GPU memory, reducing bottlenecks. GPU scheduling optimizes the timing of operations to maximize utilization and minimize idle time. Autoscaling adjusts the number of GPUs or resources based on the workload's demand, ensuring flexibility and cost-effectiveness. Each of these factors is critical to maintaining a smooth decoding process and adapting to varying data volumes.
